title: SnapshotValue

url.description: The address the page has now.

text.description: The accessibility tree, one element per line with its role, name, state and value, and a ref on each element that can be acted on.

totalChars.description: How long the whole snapshot is, in characters.

truncated.description: Whether the text was cut at maxChars: at the last line boundary within them, or mid-line when no line ends within them.

midLine.description: Present when the text was cut mid-line, as no line ends within maxChars: at maxChars, or short of a character written as two code units or a ref the cut would split.

challenge.description: The challenge the page shows, when it shows one.

description: The page as an accessibility tree: frames stitched and open shadow roots included, field values the serialiser never reads left out.
